name: Halong Bay Heritage Marathon
short_description: A full marathon (42.195 km) and half marathon (21.1 km) taking place on November 22, 2026, in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam.
ai_summary: The Halong Bay Heritage Marathon is a full marathon and half marathon event scheduled for November 22, 2026, in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam. Runners can choose between the 42.195 km marathon distance or the 21.1 km half marathon option. The race is set against the backdrop of Ha Long Bay in Quang Ninh province.
pros: Fast, fully closed out-and-back course on the Ha Long coast road; 2:13:57 race record in 2025
Water and medical posts about every 2 km on the marathon course
Four distances: marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km
Big field of over 14,000 runners, more than 3,000 from abroad
cons: Tight marathon checkpoint: 26 km within 3 hours 50 in 2025
Ha Long is about three and a half hours by bus from Hanoi
No refunds; transfers cost 300,000 VND and closed about seven weeks before the 2025 race
Fake social-media pages have sold bogus bibs for the 2026 race; register only through official channels

faqs.question: When is the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Halong Bay Heritage Marathon is scheduled to take place on November 22, 2026. It will be held in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam. This date applies to both the full marathon and half marathon distances offered as part of the event, giving runners a clear target date to prepare for.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Halong Bay Heritage Marathon offers two distance options for participants: a full marathon of 42.195 km, which is the primary distance for the event, and a half marathon of 21.1 km. Both distances will be run on the same date, November 22, 2026, in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam.

faqs.question: Where is the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Halong Bay Heritage Marathon takes place in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam. This venue serves as the location for both the full marathon (42.195 km) and half marathon (21.1 km) distances, with the event scheduled to occur on November 22, 2026 in this Vietnamese city.
